name: San Jose City Hall in the plaza (Market Plaza / City Park)
shape_note: City hall in the middle of the plaza (now Plaza de Cesar Chavez), 1887-1958 per Metro Silicon Valley 1997 ('Old City Hall'), demolished 1958 after the city moved to the new civic centre on N. First St. Footprint traced from the 1915 Sanborn sheet 90 (id 004_0090_b16, brick, 972 m2; 1950 sheet: 008_0090_b50) - prefer the traced geometry; height not found. start_year: construction 1887-1889 (ESTIMATE 1887 as given by the source).

name: Hotel Montgomery at its original site (S. First St at San Antonio St)
shape_note: William Binder's 1911 hotel was moved 57 m (187 ft) south on 29 Jan 2000 to 211 S. First St, where it stands (reopened 2004): this row is the building at its first site only (1911-2000). Footprint traced from the 1915 Sanborn sheet 90 (004_0090_f56, 2,198 m2 incl. the wing; 1950: 008_0090_x84). Storeys 4 = ESTIMATE from photos (not read off the sheet).

name: Naval Hospital Oakland (Oak Knoll): main hospital building
shape_note: Oak Knoll Naval Hospital opened 1942 in temporary wards; ground broken 7 Dec 1965 for the permanent 597-bed hospital, completed mid-1968; base closed 1996; the 11-storey main building was imploded 8 Apr 2011. Position = the article's coordinate (three decimals, about +/-100 m: LOW CONFIDENCE); footprint 90x25 m and height (11 x 3.9 m) are ESTIMATES. The wartime wards around it are not drawn.

name: Hotel Vendome (549 N. First St, San Jose)
shape_note: Queen Anne resort hotel of 150 rooms in 11 acres of grounds (Jacob Lenzen & Son, 1888-89; annex wing 1903), closed 30 Apr 1930 and demolished; the grounds were subdivided (houses of the 1930s-50s stand there today). Position = the article's coordinate; footprint 75x18 m and 3 storeys are ESTIMATES from photographs (main block only, towers and the annex not drawn).

name: J. Henry Meyer Memorial Library (Stanford)
shape_note: Undergraduate library by John Carl Warnecke, dedicated 2 Dec 1966, closed 22 Aug 2014 and demolished Feb-Mar 2015 (now Meyer Green). Position = the article's coordinate; footprint 60x60 m, 4 storeys and height are ESTIMATES (square pavilion with a deep colonnade).

name: Warren Hall (Cal State East Bay, Hayward)
shape_note: 13-storey administration tower of the Hayward campus, built 1969-71, seen from across the bay; seismically unsafe (Hayward fault), imploded 17 Aug 2013. Position = the article's coordinate; footprint 30x30 m and height (13 x 3.9 m) are ESTIMATES.

name: Cowell Memorial Hospital (UC Berkeley)
shape_note: Student hospital by Arthur Brown Jr. (entrance and south wing 1930, later additions), NRHP-listed 6 Jan 1993 and demolished the same year for the Haas School of Business (1995, today's footprints). Position = the article's coordinate; footprint 50x30 m and 4 storeys are ESTIMATES.
